description: This file defines the 'InterruptProcessException' class in the 'OrangeHRM\Installer\Exception' namespace, which extends the built-in PHP 'Exception' class. It serves as a custom exception to signal interruptions within the installer process of the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: InterruptProcessException
classes.description: A custom exception class used within the installer component of OrangeHRM, extending the base Exception class to provide specific signaling of process interruptions.
